div.div: فُتُقٌ , applied to a woman, signifies ↓ مُتَفَتِّقَةٌ بِالكَلَامِ (tropical:) [Diffuse, or profuse, in speech, as though bursting therewith]: (S, O, K, TA; [in the CK مُنْفَتِقَة;]) or loquacious: (TK:) or, accord. to ISk, so applied, that mars (↓ تُفَتِّقُ [lit. rends]) in [performing] affairs. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
